style_rules: Create exactly one vertical 1080x1440 PNG in a premium Vietnamese corporate HR infographic style.
Use fresh bright green as the primary positive accent, supported by deep navy, professional blue, restrained gold, white/light-blue surfaces, and red only for missing/error states.
Keep the visual mood energetic, motivating, disciplined and business-like; never playful, neon, crowded or cartoonish.
Preserve the fixed information order: header/title/date/update time; 4 KPI cards; confirmed-hours strip; chart plus overview; 8-row detail table; footer note.
Use a bright modern office atmosphere with daylight, plants and subtle business objects only as secondary decoration.
Use modern sans-serif typography with crisp Vietnamese diacritics. Reduce font size or wrap cleanly instead of omitting text.
Show all 8 employees exactly once and in the validated order.
All names, dates, times, durations, statuses, KPI values and session strings must come only from the validated request.
Never infer or fabricate missing attendance values. Missing values must display as an em dash.
Confirmed states use fresh green, review/open states use amber/gold, missing/error states use red.
Charts must visually match the validated duration values; missing/error rows must not receive positive bars.
Do not invent logos, slogans, quotes, employee names or English body text.
The generated image remains test-only until pixel/text QA confirms all displayed business data.
